component.name: AerialPod
component.summary: Podcast player that syncs with gpodder.net and AntennaPod

description.p: A desktop podcast player that syncs with gpodder.net and plays nicely with AntennaPod on your phone.

ul.li: Queue derived from synced episode actions, with your own pins and reordering kept
Device-to-device sync of queue order and per-podcast settings over a LAN or VPN
Only the next queue item is downloaded; everything else streams
MPRIS media keys and per-podcast speed and skip settings
